name: Subscription Module — one catalog of services, plans built in admin, per-seat add-ons, monthly/quarterly/(annual)
summary: Every feature is a catalog service; Free, Pro, Autopilot and the organization plan are versioned compositions an admin publishes at any time: a base, included services, optional add-ons with prices, per-seat rules. One pricing engine (list → contract → one discount → tier; Kiwiply prorates) and one EntitlementService for personal and org contexts; Stripe stays the truth. Annual billing is on (user decision S-01, 2026-10-15); the yearly discount is admin-set under the margin guard.
notes: Design: docs/subscriptions/ (README index). Decisions with safe defaults: docs/subscriptions/decisions-for-user.md (S-01 … S-23; S-01, S-03, S-19, S-20 answered 2026-10-15). CLAUDE.md wins on conflict.
Every price, cap, interval, discount and floor is a catalog row or a settings-registry key (03 §2, 08 §7). No story ships a constant.

Billing DoD on every story: money in long minor units; idempotent changes; valid (effective-dated, immutable) price versions; historical traceability (quote + invoice snapshots); reconciliation; PersonalSubscriptionUnchangedIT, BillingResourceIT, BillingWebhookIT, EntitlementServiceTest green and unchanged.
K supersedes/relates the overlapping B1–B3/B9/B10 (pay), A3 (admin) and X5/X6 (ent) stories; nothing is deleted — superseded stories show 'Superseded by' in the roadmap.

Annual billing is ON (S-01 answered): K9 stories sit in the normal build order (10 §3). No existing subscribers today (S-03 answered): the migration is a no-data migration; immutable price versions and never-silently-re-price stay as rules for future cohorts.
